dem_flow_direction — DEM hydrology op

• Data kinds: depth → labels

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.dem_flow_direction(dem, cell_size, nodata='error') (to call the implementation directly, import demops; demops.dem_flow_direction(dem, cell_size, nodata='error'); from the registry, opsdem.get("dem_flow_direction"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

D8 flow direction. O'Callaghan & Mark (1984).

The return value is an integer of (H, W), where 0-7 is the sequence of _D8 and -1 is the sequence of _D8. “No destination” (depression). Boundary cells of nodata="outlet" have 0-7 going out of bounds.

If nodata="outlet", then allow the flow to go to the missing cell (exit the system there). If it is barrier'', it will not lead to missing data. Missing cells themselves are always -1.
